item.title: Central African Republic: the situation
item.description:
CAR forces have completed Rwanda special forces and basic special operations training and have neutralised 34 Boko Haram and ISWAP fighters in the Lake Chad area. The UN Security Council has renewed the MINUSCA mandate to 2027, lowered the troop ceiling to 12,000 and ordered a gradual drawdown of peacekeepers. Saudi backing now funds a second year of a counter-terrorism programme for Sahel states centred on Chad. Tensions are rising between Chad and Niger as regional realignments shift, and a prison break in Chad caused two inmate deaths and 30 escapes. The UCDP counted 246 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
